parameters.query:
SELECT 
  b.*, 
  c.phone as client_phone, 
  c.name as client_name, 
  s.name as staff_name,
  (SELECT string_agg(b2."bookingCode", '، ') FROM "Booking" b2 WHERE (b2."paymobIntentionId" = b."paymobIntentionId" AND b."paymobIntentionId" IS NOT NULL) OR b2.id = b.id) as all_booking_codes,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM "Booking" b2 WHERE (b2."paymobIntentionId" = b."paymobIntentionId" AND b."paymobIntentionId" IS NOT NULL) OR b2.id = b.id) as group_count
FROM "Booking" b
LEFT JOIN "Client" c ON b.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN "Staff" s ON b.staff_id = s.id
WHERE b.id = '{{ $json.bookingId }}'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT id FROM "Booking"
WHERE staff_id = '{{ $json.staff_id }}'
  AND status = 'confirmed'
  AND id != '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND "bookingDate" >= '{{ $json.bookingDate.substring(0,10) }}T00:00:00'
  AND "bookingDate" < '{{ $json.bookingDate.substring(0,10) }}T23:59:59'
  AND (
    ("bookingDate" < '{{ $json.endTime }}' AND "endTime" > '{{ $json.bookingDate }}')
  );

UPDATE "Booking"
SET status = 'confirmed',
    "depositStatus" = 'paid',
    "paymobTxnId" = '{{ $('Parse Payment').item.json.txnId }}'
WHERE ("paymobIntentionId" IS NOT NULL AND "paymobIntentionId" = '{{ $('Get Booking').item.json.paymobIntentionId }}')
   OR id = '{{ $('Get Booking').item.json.id }}';

UPDATE "Booking"
SET status = 'cancelled',
    "depositStatus" = 'paid',
    "paymobTxnId" = '{{ $('Parse Payment').item.json.txnId }}',
    notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' - تعارض في الموعد بعد الدفع، يحتاج استرداد العربون'
WHERE ("paymobIntentionId" IS NOT NULL AND "paymobIntentionId" = '{{ $('Get Booking').item.json.paymobIntentionId }}')
   OR id = '{{ $('Get Booking').item.json.id }}';
